heading: Install and sign in to helpers from Settings
body: Install and Sign in buttons for your AI helpers: in Settings under Your AI helpers, a missing helper (Codex, OpenCode, Freebuff, Gemini CLI, Claude Code) has an Install button. It needs Node.js on your PC and takes about a minute. A signed-out helper has Sign in, which opens its own sign-in window; you sign in there with your own account, and Meldmind never sees your password. Antigravity is not installed this way, so it gets a Get it button for its download page.
